title: Remote command relay and local authorization flow
purpose: Route a controller-authenticated command through a device-isolated outbound relay session, then preserve local policy as final execution authority and stream the bounded result back.
entry_condition: A controller queues a structured command for a known device.
authority: Relay authentication controls transport access; the local PC agent policy remains final execution authority.

transitions.action: authenticate controller and enqueue bounded request
side_effects: append request to bounded in-memory device queue

transitions.action: authenticate current device session on outbound long poll
lease first available command for bounded interval
future agent verifies signed envelope freshness and replay state
side_effects: record nonce only after valid verification

transitions.action: automatic dispatcher executes only read-only allowed tools; privileged tools stop at approval-required
side_effects: bounded local read-only effects only for automatic tools

transitions.action: owning device session submits bounded result
side_effects: complete queued request and retain bounded result

transitions.action: controller-authenticated SSE emits one result event

invariants: registration and controller bootstrap secrets are distinct
session token is bound to one device ID
old token is invalid after reconnect rotation
controller cannot use device session token as controller authority
local policy remains final execution authority
remote payload cannot self-assert trusted local approval
failure_behavior: invalid or expired credentials fail closed
unknown and shell capabilities deny locally
relay timeout does not fabricate a result
restart_behavior: relay restart loses in-memory sessions queues and results and therefore requires device reconnect; durability is OPEN
agent restart-safe nonce replay remains OPEN
rollback_behavior: revert candidate commit if acceptance regression is confirmed
